def hat(x,k):
    # piecewise linear hat basis
    h=np.zeros((len(x),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        left = knots[j-1] if j>0 else -np.inf
        right= knots[j+1] if j<len(knots)-1 else np.inf
        c=knots[j]
        y=np.zeros_like(x)
        m1=(x>=left)&(x<=c)&(j>0); y[m1]=(x[m1]-left)/(c-left)
        m2=(x>=c)&(x<=right)&(j<len(knots)-1); y[m2]=(right-x[m2])/(right-c)
        if j==0: y[x<=c]=1 if True else 0
        h[:,j]=y
    return h

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def mdl2(q,t,P):
    w,qq=q[0],q[1]
    s=np.sin(w*t); co=np.cos(w*t); ed=np.exp(-qq*t)
    X=[np.ones_like(t),t,P,P**2,P*np.log(P),np.log(P),1/P,t/P,s/P,co/P,ed/P,t*ed/P,s,co,s*P,co*P]
    return np.c_[tuple(X)]
def resf(q):
    A=mdl2(q,t,P); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]; return A@c-dP_dt
